messages:
sam: Customer in us-west opened an escalation: streaming SSE from our API truncates after ~75-95s, then client reconnect causes repeated overlap of seq window (e.g. seq 200..210 then 200..210 again). They see duplicate payloads and duplicate billing impressions.
maria: Which frontend stack are they on? ALB / Cloudflare / nginx chain? Need repro + nginx conf + ALB idle timeout.
sam: They have Cloudflare in front -> ALB -> nginx (reverse proxy) -> app (go sse). Reported nginx 1.18 on EC2, ALB default idle 60s. They attached a minimal curl command they used: 
```
curl -i -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=mistral-lite"
```
They say connection is fine for ~80s, then stalls, ctrl+C and reconnect -> server resumes but overlaps last ~10 seq numbers.
jon: Could be ALB idle timeout or ALB sending FIN on health-probe collision. Also Cloudflare can coalesce/aggregate chunks and suppress immediate flushes. Do we have server logs around the TCP half-close?
kevin: App logs would help. Also check if client sends Last-Event-ID or similar; if reconnect doesn't pass last-known event id, server may reissue a recent buffer. Best practice: client sends X-Last-Seq header or Last-Event-ID and server makes reconnections idempotent.
sam: Customer provided server logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-09T09:02:10Z] sse: stream open client=10.4.5.6 seq=180
[2026-03-09T09:03:30Z] sse: write_error short_write bytes=128
[2026-03-09T09:03:31Z] net: connection half-close detected from upstream
[2026-03-09T09:03:31Z] sse: reconnect token=abcd last_sent_seq=190
[2026-03-09T09:03:31Z] sse: resume base_seq=181
```
That resume base_seq=181 while last_sent_seq=190 explains overlapping 181..190 replay.
maria: That upstream short_write is consistent with nginx/ALB reacting to an idle or probe. If ALB idle timeout is 60s and no keepalive heartbeat from SSE, ALB can send FIN and nginx may half-close to app.
jon: They said keepalive configured but not SSE heartbeat. Recommend enabling small SSE heartbeat (comment: send `: ping\n\n` every 15s) to keep ALB and Cloudflare from idling.
kevin: Nginx settings we recommend on origin reverse-proxy for SSE: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_set_header Connection ""; send_timeout 300; keepalive_timeout 300  keepalive_requests 10000;` Also ensure `proxy_buffer_size` and `proxy_busy_buffers_size` are tuned for small events.
sam: Customer also uses Cloudflare with "Full (strict)" TLS and default caching. Cloudflare will sometimes buffer with its HTTP/2 path and aggregate small frames. For streaming, set "Bypass cache" or Page Rule to disable buffering and enable "Origin server keepalive". If using Cloudflare Workers, ensure the worker streams response rather than assembling.
maria: Short-term workaround for customer: (1) set ALB idle timeout >= 120s, (2) set nginx `proxy_buffering off`, (3) add SSE heartbeat every 10-15s. That should prevent mid-stream FINs.
jon: Longer-term: server should accept `Last-Event-ID` or `X-Last-Seq` on reconnect and treat it as an ack cursor so it doesn't resend <= last_acked. Also clients should dedupe on seq. We'll add a compatibility header and versioned behavior to server.
kevin: For repro in our lab: emulate chain with Cloudflare worker (or a simple HTTP/2 aggregator), ALB-like proxy (simulate idle FIN after Xs with socat), and nginx with default buffering then toggle `proxy_buffering off`. Steps I used locally: 
1) small Go SSE server: send event `id: <seq>\ndata: {...}\n\n` every 200ms.
2) nginx reverse proxy default config, curl connect for 90s, kill ALB-like connection -> observe resume dup.
3) toggle `proxy_buffering off` + add heartbeat -> dup stops.
sam: I reproduced locally with nginx default and ALB simulator. Duplicate ~10 events after reconnect. With `proxy_buffering off` and heartbeat 10s, reconnect yields continuous seq with no overlap.
infra-bot: Ticket INC-2026 created for streaming reconnect duplication: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/INC-2026
maria: Action items for this thread:
- Support: ask customer for nginx conf, ALB idle timeout, Cloudflare config, pcap of one incident (pcap of client<->cloudflare and cloudflare<->alb if possible).
- Infra: add automated regression that runs nginx 1.18/1.22 with ALB idle simulation + optional Cloudflare worker to catch replay/dup cases.
- Product: publish SSE deployment guide (recommended nginx flags, ALB/NLB idle guidance, Cloudflare page rules + worker streaming note).
- Runtime: implement `X-Last-Seq` support and opt-in server cursoring, and an idempotent replay path.
kevin: Also note double-billing risk: when server re-emits previously sent tokens, billing counters may double-count unless deduped at request layer. Ensure billing uses monotonic unique event ids.
sam: I've sent the initial workaround checklist to customer and requested pcap + nginx conf. Will update ticket INC-2026 when we get files.
maria: Good. Also add a KB article linking to this guide and the typical config snippets. :memo:
sam: I'll attach my local repro steps and the minimal nginx config that fixed it to the ticket.
kevin: Example nginx snippet we should publish (tested):
```
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_request_buffering off;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
proxy_buffers 4 32k;
proxy_busy_buffers_size 64k;
send_timeout 300;
keepalive_timeout 300;
```
maria: Thanks everyone. Keep the thread updated when customer uploads pcap. :eyes:
